confirmDescriptions.installment_remind_3d: Sends the standard “3 days before due” installment template for this installment.
confirmDescriptions.installment_remind_1d: Sends the standard “1 day before due” installment template for this installment.
confirmDescriptions.installment_remind_today: Sends the standard “due today” installment reminder for this installment.
confirmDescriptions.installment_remind_remaining_days: Sends an email stating how many whole calendar days remain (UTC) until this installment due date.
confirmDescriptions.installment_send_overdue: Sends the notice that this installment is overdue (after the due date end in UTC).
